description_en: Associates host accounts with a shared key
description_zh: 关联主机账号到主机共享密钥
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-accounts-to-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-id 10267 --host-account-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostAccountsToHostShareKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bastion host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the bastion host. For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 堡垒机的地域ID。Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The shared key ID.

> You must specify this parameter. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to query the shared key ID
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
> 此参数为必传参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The host account IDs.

> You must specify this parameter. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462937.html operation to query the host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号的ID列表。
> 此参数为必传参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462937.html接口获取该参数
